d:
Israil men hue aam chunavon ke antim natijon men na to binyamin netanyahu ke gathbandhan ko aur na hi yahudi vipaksh ko sansad men bahumat mila hai. ummid ke ulat do arab partiyon ke gathbandhnon, da joint list aur ram ko 120 siton vali israili sansad men rikord 19 siten mili hain. isse ye donon arab gathbandhan sarkar ke gathan men aham bhumika nibhane ki sthiti men aa gae hain.
Ab israil ke rashtrapti harzog sabhi rajnitik dalon ke sath batchit karenge aur uske bad hi vo kisi neta ko sarkar banane ke lie aamantrit karenge. is prakriya men kaee hafte lag sakte hain.
